summary: Workers/D1 adapter for the model gateway data plane (#347, streaming #348): gateway-core GatewayPorts over D1 and createGatewayApp mounted at /gateway/v1/* by routes/gateway.ts, which passes ctx.waitUntil so a disconnected stream still settles. Guide: apps/docs/guide/gateway-data-plane.md.
context_hints: Decisions (routing, holds, pricing, coded errors, the HTTP flow) live in @clash/gateway-core; these files only make them durable. Never re-implement them here.
D1 columns are unix seconds, gateway-core is epoch ms: convert through d1-common.ts only.
Identity is the sk_gw_ token (services/gateway-tokens.ts) with the models:invoke scope; no header, x-user-id included, is identity.
Official upstream secrets: secret_ref may only name a GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_* Worker secret; envelopes are sealed under GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY (never ACTION_SECRET_KEY). No key material in errors or logs.
Unimplemented ports (scheduler, audit) are unavailablePort (501), never silent no-ops.

Body retention (#353, decision 2026-10-20): blobs = R2 (R2_BUCKET, prefix gateway-retention/), retention = D1 gateway_request_retention metadata only. On only when GATEWAY_STAFF_PROMPT_ACCESS=enabled (hosted); purge runs regardless from the scheduled handler. Never store headers or upstream credentials. Streams are retained as delivered, capped; a cut copy is response_truncated = 1 (0039).
Stale holds (#348): sweepGatewayHolds (d1-budgets.ts) runs from the scheduled handler and POST /api/v1/admin/gateway/holds/sweep; it never touches settle_failed holds.

key_files.index.ts: createD1GatewayPorts, workerSecrets, staffPromptAccessEnabled, createCloudflareGatewayApp (basePath /gateway, retention per the flag).
key_files.r2-blobs.ts: gateway-core blobs over the R2 bucket; failures are GATEWAY_INTERNAL.
key_files.d1-retention.ts: gateway-core retention over gateway_request_retention (0037, truncation columns 0039); gatewayRetentionPorts and purgeGatewayRetention for the scheduled handler and the admin purge route.
key_files.d1-routes.ts: Published catalog from gateway_model.card_json, official accounts from gateway_upstream_account (tenant scope: none), price book from published gateway_price rows effective at the admission instant (newest version first, exact upstream over model-wide).
key_files.d1-price-book.ts: #352 price-book admin: list, draft (replaced wholly in one batch), publish (one UPDATE; effective_from never before the publish instant). Published rows are immutable; every mutation writes gateway_admin_audit in the same batch.
key_files.d1-billing.ts: #352 credit billing: packages, top-up packs, subscribe (first-period grant), top-up, cancel, idempotent rollover (expire unused grant + next grant), wallet summary. Each operation is one changes()-chained batch with a CHECK-violation guard; ledger request ids are the idempotency anchors.
key_files.d1-billing.test.ts: Price book + billing on node:sqlite: draft/publish, effective dates, no repricing through the real data plane, grant/topup/expire idempotency, team wallet, coded atomic refusals.
key_files.d1-credentials.ts: Official credential resolution (secret_ref or sealed envelope), fail closed with GATEWAY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE; sealGatewayUpstreamCredentials.
key_files.d1-budgets.ts: All-or-nothing reserve in one batch (CHECK-violation guard rolls back), single-batch settle writing per-budget settle rows; ledger reads. No budget row = refused. expiredHolds/expire + sweepGatewayHolds: open holds past expires_at -> expired with a zero-cost expired settle row, once.
key_files.d1-limits.ts: rate_limit_json from key / model / subscription, counted in gateway_rate_window and gateway_inflight (0034).
key_files.d1-common.ts: Time conversion, monotonic clock, published-catalog subquery, JSON helpers.
key_files.d1-admin-audit.ts: #353 the one gateway_admin_audit writer: adminAuditStatement (a statement for the mutation's own batch, chained on changes()) and redactAuditValue (secret keys and credential-shaped values become [redacted]). Rows are append-only (0036 triggers).
key_files.d1-catalog-admin.ts: #353 catalog admin over gateway_model: list (live marked), clone into a draft, upsert/remove draft models (ModelCardSchema + DeepSeek Flash-only policy), publish (the whole version, then immutable).
key_files.d1-upstream-admin.ts: #353 official upstream accounts: list/create/update/disable/rotate. Secrets are write-only (secret_ref name or sealed at once); views and audit carry kind, field names and key_version only.
key_files.d1-tenant-admin.ts: #353/#392 member/key budgets (below-usage refused), key rate limits, members and owner/member roles (last owner kept; role changes are for team settings #354, not the console). Each write + audit in one CAS batch.
key_files.d1-platform-roles.ts: #353 platform_admin grants (gateway_platform_role): list, grant, revoke (never the last one), audited.
key_files.platform-admin-bootstrap.ts: #353 dependency-free bootstrap SQL and argument parsing for scripts/gateway-platform-admin.ts (local or staging only, idempotent).
key_files.d1-admin-reads.ts: #353 console reads: ledger usage + per-model totals, audit filter, overview metrics, tenants, abuse rate-window counters (denied events not recorded yet).
key_files.test-support.ts: Test-only seeding and the shared gateway-core contract harness over these ports (node:sqlite unit run and miniflare run).
key_files.d1-gateway.test.ts: Contract on node:sqlite, /gateway/v1 through createApp (spoofed x-user-id ignored, coded 401/402/403/404/502, a stream byte for byte with settlement and retention), body retention (flag on/off, R2 failure coded and billing unchanged, no credentials stored), the hold sweep, credential custody.
